description: This file exports constants and a module related to diagram representations within a requirement management or visualization tool, including configuration, element creation, relationship rendering, and styling for diagrams implemented in JavaScript.

classes.name: V
classes.description: Parser class for the specialized diagram markup language, providing methods to parse diagram source text into internal representations.

methods.name: addRequirement
methods.description: Adds a requirement object to the internal requirements collection with specified parameters.

methods.name: setNewReqId
methods.description: Sets a new identifier for the current requirement being processed.

methods.name: setNewReqText
methods.description: Sets the descriptive text for the current requirement.

methods.name: setNewReqRisk
methods.description: Sets the risk level for the current requirement.

methods.name: setNewReqVerifyMethod
methods.description: Associates a verification method with the current requirement.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Adds a diagram element (like requirement or element) to the internal collection.

methods.name: setNewElementType
methods.description: Defines the type of the new diagram element.

methods.name: setNewElementDocRef
methods.description: Associates a documentation reference with the diagram element.

methods.name: addRelationship
methods.description: Establishes a relationship link between source and destination elements with a specified type.

methods.name: getRequirements
methods.description: Returns the stored collection of requirements.

methods.name: getElements
methods.description: Returns the stored collection of diagram elements.

methods.name: getRelationships
methods.description: Returns the collection of relationship links between elements.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets all internal collections and data related to requirements, elements, and relationships.
